lines.en: I drift; I do not walk.

lines.zh: 绳子拖在地上，我跟着风
lines.en: My string drags; I follow the wind.

lines.zh: 我走一步，其实是被吹一步
lines.en: Each step is really a push of air.
My feet hang half a block above ground.
Wind from the left pushes me right.
Drifting, I end up behind you.
My shadow chases me from below.
Only trees change my direction.
I never tire; I stop when the wind does.
Slow, silent, drifting.

lines.zh: 我在半空晃，绳子也在晃
lines.en: I sway in the air, string swaying too.
I drift into a doorway and catch.
I hang here, perfectly still.
My string has looped around itself.

lines.zh: 气球该有的样子我都长着
lines.en: I look exactly as a balloon should.
Floating costs me less than standing.
I am light, unnaturally light.

lines.zh: 有风的时候我才像在动
lines.en: Only wind makes me seem alive.
I hover at the height of your head.
My surface catches the light.
I will not pop, not yet.
I am quiet; my string is not.

lines.zh: 在房间里我显得不合尺寸
lines.en: Indoors, I look the wrong size.
I slowly turned full around.
Hovering makes me look lighter.

lines.zh: 你看得见我里面什么都没有
lines.en: You can see there is nothing inside me.

lines.zh: 我在你的上方，等你抬头
lines.en: I am above you, waiting for you to look up.
When you look up, I am facing you.

lines.zh: 我的圆面没有五官，却像在看
lines.en: My round face has no features, yet seems to watch.
I hover level with your face.
Do not look up; I will keep waiting.

lines.zh: 我的绷紧的那一面朝你
lines.en: My taut side is turned toward you.
The string dangles onto your shoulder.
I am half a block taller than you.

lines.zh: 你在判断我是不是真的
lines.en: You are deciding if I am real.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住你的眼睛
lines.en: My shadow covers your eyes.

lines.zh: 我从下面看你，不太方便
lines.en: Watching you from below is awkward.
I drift to your eye level.
Raising your hand for the string?
I do not blink; balloons cannot.
I come near your face, silent.
You step back; I stay put.

lines.zh: 我的光面映出你歪掉的脸
lines.en: My glossy side shows your distorted face.
This room is too low for me.
You have been looking up a long while.

lines.zh: 我一直在你耳边的高度
lines.en: I stay at the height of your ear.

lines.zh: 我被戳了一下，晃得厉害
lines.en: Something poked me; I sway hard.
My surface wrinkled.
No pain, but my string frayed.
That emptied a little air from me.
I swayed into your face before stopping.
Do not poke me; it leaves a mark.
I sank one block.
Balloons hold grudges too.
I bounced back into the wall.
A little torn, not yet leaking.

lines.zh: 绳子垂在你面前，像在请你
lines.en: My string dangles before you, inviting.
Grab me and I will go with you.
Food? I would rather have wind.

lines.zh: 你举起食物，我飘高了一点
lines.en: You lift the food; I float a little higher.

lines.zh: 那个味道把我的绳子吹动了
lines.en: That smell moves my string.
I circled the food half a turn.
You mean to tether me with sweets.

lines.zh: 我不吃，但我喜欢被举起来
lines.en: I do not eat, but I like being lifted.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西比空气重
lines.en: What you hold is heavier than air.

lines.zh: 我贴过去，只为蹭一下风
lines.en: I press close just to borrow the breeze.
You hit me; I swayed three times.

lines.zh: 我的绳子缠上了你的手
lines.en: My string wrapped around your hand.
One touch and I drift away.
I am light; you barely felt it.

lines.zh: 我们碰在一起没有声音
lines.en: Our contact made no sound.
Your head bounced me upward.

lines.zh: 绳子在你身上打了个结
lines.en: The string knotted against you.

lines.zh: 我的表面凹了一下又弹回
lines.en: My surface dented, then sprang back.
You pushed me to the ceiling.
Bumping is rude to a balloon.

lines.zh: 气球不需要伴侣，需要风
lines.en: Balloons need no mate, only wind.
I sway toward the curtains.

lines.zh: 两个气球只会缠在一起
lines.en: Two balloons would only tangle.
I try to approach your shadow.
No offspring, only air.

lines.zh: 我这般轻盈，配对太重了
lines.en: I am too light; pairing is too heavy.
I circled you once.
One of me is enough.
I leak air when no one is watching.

lines.zh: 别把我绑在别的东西上
lines.en: Do not tie me to anything else.
I curl around the small thing you dropped.
My string hooked it.
I lift it just a little.
It is too heavy; I cannot lift it far.
See, I can serve as a hand.
I pick it up and set it down softly.
This is more interesting than drifting.

lines.zh: 你找不到的东西，往往在我下面
lines.en: What you lose is often beneath me.
When the string slackens, it drops.

lines.zh: 我是气球，却总在捡东西
lines.en: A balloon, yet always picking things up.
My string slowly points at you.
You are beneath me, very clear.
I have decided to drift after you.

lines.zh: 你走到哪，绳子就跟到哪
lines.en: Where you walk, the string follows.
I am slow, but I never lose my way.
I lock on above your head.

lines.zh: 你抬头的那一瞬，我选中你
lines.en: The moment you look up, I choose you.

lines.zh: 空气把我推向你的方向
lines.en: The air pushes me toward you.
This column of air has me in it.

lines.zh: 我不需要理由，风就是理由
lines.en: I need no reason; the wind is reason.

lines.zh: 我飘低的动作就是答应
lines.en: My sinking motion is my answer.
Your shadow is my map.

lines.zh: 我跟的不是你，是你的温度
lines.en: I follow not you, but your warmth.

lines.zh: 别跑，我会一直浮在你身后
lines.en: Do not run; I will float behind you.
Locked on, without a sound.
I hold two blocks above your head.
You go inside; I squeeze through the frame.
I drift with your breathing.
You turn; I follow slowly.
My string hangs lower and lower.
I am always at the top of your view.

lines.zh: 你感觉头顶有东西，对吧
lines.en: You feel something overhead, right?

lines.zh: 我不用追，只等你自己停
lines.en: I need not chase; I wait for you to stop.
When the wind stops, so do I.

lines.zh: 你在梯子上，我在上面等
lines.en: You climb; I wait at the top.

lines.zh: 我把你头顶的光挡掉一半
lines.en: I block half the light above you.

lines.zh: 你走得越远，我的绳子越长
lines.en: The farther you go, the longer my string.

lines.zh: 我在你身后留不下脚印
lines.en: I leave no footprints behind you.

lines.zh: 你会一直听见轻轻的晃
lines.en: You will keep hearing a faint sway.
I drift against your hat.
There is a circle in the middle of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我不用方向，只要你在下
lines.en: I need no direction, only you below.

lines.zh: 你停下来时，我贴得更近
lines.en: When you stop, I press closer.
We drift down the same corridor.
Do not leave me on the ceiling.
I drop on you whole.

lines.zh: 我的绳子先甩到你脸上
lines.en: My string whips your face first.

lines.zh: 我没什么重量，但会吓人
lines.en: I have little weight, but I startle.
I graze past your ear.
A balloon strikes: the lightest blow.
I press down on your head.
This hit is mostly sound.
You swat; I bounce away.

lines.zh: 我的表面在你护甲上滑过
lines.en: My surface slides over your armor.
After the hit I float higher.
You stepped back from the fright.
I am not good at this, truly.
The string snaps at your wrist.
I fall, then rise again.

lines.zh: 这一击之后我瘪了一点
lines.en: That blow left me slightly deflated.
Do not expect a balloon to be heavy.
I drifted into this room.
A circle appeared under the ceiling.
I have no footsteps, only sway.
When I appeared, my string landed first.
The room suddenly feels full.
I came in with that gust from the window.

lines.zh: 你听见绳子擦墙的声音
lines.en: You hear string scraping the wall.
I hang in the doorway, still.
There is another shadow under the lamp.

lines.zh: 你回头，我在你眼睛的高度
lines.en: Turn around; I am at your eye level.
I was not born; I simply appeared.
A circle squeezed out of the air.

lines.zh: 我进得太突然，绳子还缠着
lines.en: I came in so fast my string is tangled.
This square is mine to hover in.

lines.zh: 你的屋里多了一个不该有的东西
lines.en: Your house now holds something it should not.

lines.zh: 我不出声，先让你注意到我
lines.en: I stay silent and let you notice me.
I am drawn tighter than before.
You do not have to look up.

lines.zh: 我就在你身后偏上一点
lines.en: I am just behind you and slightly above.

lines.zh: 这是第一次，还会有下一次
lines.en: This is the first; there will be more.
Fire melted a corner of me.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，弹了两下
lines.en: I fell from above and bounced twice.

lines.zh: 水面压着我，我浮不上去
lines.en: The water holds me down; I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我震成一片薄膜
lines.en: The blast flattened me into film.
The arrow pierced me; I hiss out air.

lines.zh: 魔法把我吹得转个不停
lines.en: Magic spun me without end.

lines.zh: 我不进食，只是慢慢瘪下去
lines.en: I do not eat; I slowly deflate.
Lightning made me see-through.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走了我里面的空气
lines.en: The void pulled the air out of me.
